verdict.rationale: The only maintenance signals are indirect. The openai/plugins repo and its curated marketplace manifest were live and fetchable in a 2026-09-06 probe and list current plugins such as Figma, Expo and build-web-apps. OpenAI also documents a submission-and-review portal through which third parties publish plugins. Missing for 10: any evidence of release cadence or recent releases, issue triage activity, and merged community pull requests to the collection repo itself.
